collection.title: Audi S3 1999 to 2003 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a 1996 to 2003 version of the Audi S3 Hatchback which requires a 21" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" for the passengers side. This model uses the Hook type arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
